DISCRETIONARY MANDATES

Focus on the big picture and leave the day-to-day investment decisions in the hands of
trusted professionals.

Does keeping on top of your investments eat up too much of your free time? And do you feel your
investment performance would be better if your portfolio were managed by a professional? If you’re
familiar with concerns such as these, our managed premium or managed exclusive offering could be an

ideal option for you.

With our discretionary solutions, our dedicated experts manage your portfolio on your behalf,
according to agreed-upon investment objectives, risk tolerance, guidelines, and a disciplined approach.

Our range of discretionary mandates covers all major asset classes and styles.

Why opt for a discretionary mandate?

How does it work?

In a first step, you explain to us your situation, personal and financial, and your objectives,
requirements, and risk appetite. We then provide you with objective advice on the investment
strategies which, based on our extensive portfolio engineering capabilities, correspond to your profile

and objectives.

that you are always up to date on your portfolio performance.

The products and services offered depend on the domicile of the client and the legal entity of Julius Baer.

WHAT SETS US APART

Our range of mandates includes:

Regionally focused mandates

A team of dedicated portfolio managers is responsible for managing your portfolio. You have direct
access to this team.
We can tailor discretionary mandates to meet your specific investment objectives, risk tolerance, and
liquidity needs. Our bespoke mandates provide access to a broad investment universe and leverage our
extensive active portfolio management expertise and proprietary investment approach.

Our investment process combines top-down analysis by our Investment Committee (ie defining the
asset allocation) and decision-making, with bottom-up portfolio management (ie our portfolio

managers make individual investment decisions based on your chosen strategy/investment approach).

All of Julius Baer’s discretionary mandates reflect our house view of the financial markets.

Our Investment Committee meets weekly as well as ad-hoc to assess markets and economic
developments, asset class weightings, and any short-term opportunities. Tactical decisions are made
based on the outcome of these assessments.

We offer tailored monthly and quarterly performance reports that you can access at any time.
